target_population: every station worldwide that can be lawfully and reproducibly accessed without paid data access

identity_policy.canonical_station_id: stable opaque identity derived from one immutable root provider alias; later provider aliases are explicit crosswalk bindings and do not mutate the canonical id
identity_policy.cross_provider_deduplication: explicit provider crosswalk/evidence only; geographic proximity is never sufficient identity evidence
identity_policy.location_history: resolved non-overlapping epochs with source alias and source-artifact digest; conflicting provider locations remain unresolved upstream

storage_policy.catalog: content-addressed bounded catalog shards referenced by manifest; no global station table is required in memory
storage_policy.observations: content-addressed provider/time/variable/spatial partitions with explicit supersession or tombstones
storage_policy.ingestion: idempotent by artifact digest; source revisions append lineage rather than overwrite prior artifacts
storage_policy.coverage: derived from active manifest references so station/provider/variable/time/spatial gaps remain observable

providers.scale_path: complete ghcnd-stations.txt and ghcnd-inventory.txt provider artifacts feed bounded content-addressed catalog shards; yearly observation acquisition uses the provider by_year archive, while subset REST remains a captured-fixture/reference path rather than the worldwide ingestion loop
